name: auto-mode
description: A Stop hook plus the /auto-mode skill: when enabled (flag file, or the session is on an exp/* branch), Claude keeps working through its own recommended next steps instead of stopping to ask, up to a capped number of continuations. A SessionStart hook tells Claude the AUTO-MODE: DONE / BLOCKED stop protocol from turn 1, so a prompt need not. A PreToolUse hook answers AskUserQuestion with the (Recommended) option when no human is there (on by default on exp/* branches only). Pushes, destructive actions and every git-guard / db-guard check stay as they are.
